name: One 97 Communications Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2000, One 97 Communications Ltd is India's leading digital ecosystem for consumers as well as merchants. As of March 31, 2021, the company has a 333 million+ client base and 21 million+ registered merchants to whom it offers payment services, financial services, and commerce and cloud services. [1]

flags.text: Free cash flow negative in 5 of the last 5 years

business.what: Paytm builds a financial system for small businesses, starting with payment acquisition and cross-selling financial services like credit, insurance, and wealth management, while leveraging AI to improve operational efficiency and profitability.

segments.name: Payments
segments.comment: Strong growth in GMV and market share, with improved pricing and positive tailwinds.

segments.name: Financial Services
segments.comment: Healthy tailwinds in lending, with personal and merchant loan distribution performing well.

segments.name: Marketing
segments.comment: Business has recovered and is showing growth momentum.

ledger.promise: Payment processing margin above 4 basis points for next few quarters
ledger.quote: But we feel pretty confident that it will stay above four basis points for the next few quarters.
ledger.actual: Payment processing basis points are not itemized in reported financial disclosures.

ledger.promise: Paytm Money to become top five player in less than next three years
ledger.quote: And we want to make Paytm Money a top five player in less than next three years.
ledger.actual: Target deadline is 3 years from Q3 FY26 (early 2029).

ledger.promise: Target 250 million useful monetizable customers in next 3-4 years
ledger.quote: in India based on the next three, four years of growth and worthwhile, monetizable, useful, I'm going to say about 250 million customers is a good number for us to aim for.
ledger.actual: Target timeline is 3-4 years from Q3 FY26.

ledger.promise: Reach 15-20% EBITDA margin in 2.5 to 3 years
ledger.quote: EBITDA, we will maintain about two and a half to three years from now, that we should be able to get to those sorts of EBITDA margins.
ledger.actual: EBITDA margin improved from 5.8% in Q4 FY26 to 8.3% in Q1 FY27 and 10.1% (Rs 267 cr) in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Indirect expenses grow significantly lower than revenue growth
ledger.quote: if we look outwards towards the next year, we do think that like we have said, this will grow significantly lower than revenue and contribution profit growth and continued operating leverage as a result of that.
ledger.actual: Revenue grew 27.6% YoY in Q1 FY27 and 28.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 while EBITDA margin expanded to 10.1%.

ledger.quote: contribution margins, we should expect between 55 to 60, but maybe more 55 to rather than 60, what was happening because of the PIDF impact.
ledger.actual: Contribution margin percentage is not separately reported in disclosed quarterly financial tables.

ledger.promise: EBITDA expected to be significantly higher than capex next year
ledger.quote: next year we expect EBITDA to be significantly higher than capex
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 EBITDA reached Rs 470 cr (203 cr Q1 + 267 cr Q2) against annual capex guidance of Rs 400 cr.

ledger.promise: FY27 overall revenue growth meaningfully better than 22%
ledger.quote: You have a guide, I think, meaningfully better than 22% overall growth.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 27.6% YoY to Rs 2,448 cr and Q2 FY27 revenue grew 28.5% YoY to Rs 2,648 cr.

ledger.promise: Annual capex of about 400 crores on inward devices count basis
ledger.quote: On capex, yes, we have said it was about 400 crores on a kind of inward devices count basis, and we expect that to be the same.
ledger.actual: Full year FY27 capex data pending annual cash flow disclosure.

ledger.promise: Target one-third market share in business
ledger.quote: So I'm going to say that our target is to take one-third market share in this business. There is nothing less than that we must settle for.
ledger.actual: Market share target reiterated in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Indirect expenses to grow at less than half of revenue growth over 3-4 quarter period
ledger.quote: our indirect expenses, including higher expenses in marketing and sales and service and cloud expenses, et cetera, should over a three to four quarter period, grow at less than half of revenue growth, right?
ledger.actual: 3-4 quarter monitoring period started in Q2 FY27.

credibility.label: high
credibility.summary: Management has consistently delivered on profitability commitments, turning around EBITDA from negative Rs 404 crore in Q2 FY25 to positive Rs 267 crore in Q2 FY27. Revenue growth has consistently tracked ahead of guided thresholds while operating leverage promises are being executed.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management projected EBITDA margins expanding towards 15-20% over 2-3 years, expressing confidence in reaching it sooner.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margins expanded from 5.8% in Q4 FY26 to 8.3% in Q1 FY27 and 10.1% (Rs 267 crore) in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management stated FY27 EBITDA would be significantly higher than capex.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 FY27 EBITDA reached Rs 470 crore (Rs 203 crore in Q1 + Rs 267 crore in Q2), already exceeding the full-year capex guide of Rs 400 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided FY27 overall revenue growth to be meaningfully higher than 22%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 27.6% YoY to Rs 2,448 crore and Q2 FY27 revenue grew 28.5% YoY to Rs 2,648 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management indicated that indirect expense growth would be contained to less than half of revenue growth rate.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Operating leverage is visible as EBITDA expanded from Rs 132 crore in Q4 FY26 to Rs 267 crore in Q2 FY27 while revenue grew 17% over the same period.

bull.point: Strong profit recovery and margin expansion
bull.evidence: EBITDA expanded from negative Rs 404 crore (-24.4% margin) in Q2 FY25 to positive Rs 267 crore (10.1% margin) in Q2 FY27.
Revenue grew 27.6% YoY in Q1 FY27 to Rs 2,448 crore and 28.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 to Rs 2,648 crore.

bull.point: Operating cash flow surplus over capex needs
bull.evidence: First half FY27 EBITDA of Rs 470 crore surpasses the annual device capex target of Rs 400 crore.

bear.point: Cloud cost escalation from entity integration duplication
bear.evidence: Management reported cloud cost spikes in Q2 FY27 caused by platform duplication while merging online and offline legal entities.

bear.point: Regulatory PIDF impact capping contribution margins
bear.evidence: Management indicated contribution margins would settle closer to 55% rather than 60% due to PIDF drag.

bear.point: Historical negative cash flow from operations
bear.evidence: Cash flow from operations was negative at -Rs 121 crore in FY25 and -Rs 743 crore in FY26.
